Speaker1: Have you ever been on an overseas trip?
Speaker2: Yeah! I went to Saipan in 2019!
Speaker1: Whoa, how was Saipan?
Speaker1: I'm curious since I've never been abroad.
Speaker2: But Saipan...
Speaker1: Yeah, yeah.
Speaker2: There are a ton of Koreans there.
Speaker2: I keep hearing Korean on the street, lol.
Speaker1: Whoa, that's cool.
Speaker1: What was the most memorable thing in Saipan?
Speaker2: I swam all day at this place called Managaha Island in Saipan!
Speaker2: I can't believe we got to have that much fun!
Speaker1: The ocean in Saipan is so pretty, it must've been great for swimming.
Speaker1: For sure, gotta enjoy it when you can.
Speaker2: For real, the ocean's like this emerald color!
Speaker1: Just hearing about it sounds so beautiful.
Speaker2: Got any memorable travel spots, name1?
Speaker1: I loved Suncheon, the bay was so beautiful.
